extensionDescription: A helper for LinkedIn Games. Auto-solve daily puzzles (Queens, Sudoku, Pinpoint, Crossclimb) with streaks and analytics.
title: LinkedIn Games
subtitle: Power up your workday puzzles with premium AI reasoning
errorChromeTabIntegration: Browser tab integration is only available inside browser extensions.
errorActiveTabNotFound: Could not find the active browser tab.
errorNavigationFailed: Failed to navigate to the $1 board automatically.
errorConnectionFailed: Could not connect to LinkedIn page. Please reload the tab and try again.
titleCompleted: Completed today! Click to navigate to $1
dailyProgress: Daily progress: $1 of $2 games completed today
dashboardTitle: Your complete LinkedIn Games solving history & statistics
dashboardSubtitle: Your complete LinkedIn Games solving history & statistics
settingApiKeyNotice: Selected model solves Crossclimb & Pinpoint. The extension never shares your key.
popupCardDesc: Prep your mind for the workday and compare results. Your scores are private unless you share them.
dashboardDescText: Analyze your performance metrics, record streaks, and trace your daily completed puzzle paths.
disclaimerText: Disclaimer: This is an independent, open-source educational project. It is not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by LinkedIn Corporation. 'LinkedIn' is a registered trademark of LinkedIn Corporation.
settingsSubtitleDesc: Configure AI model integration endpoints and credentials for advanced puzzle-solving reasoning.
settingsGeminiGuideDesc: Outstanding performance at near-zero costs. Solves Crossclimb and Pinpoint with excellent logic. Recommended default: gemini-2.5-flash.
settingsOpenaiGuideDesc: Fast, responsive, and extremely reliable with general knowledge patterns. Recommended default: gpt-4o-mini.
settingsAnthropicGuideDesc: Maximum reasoning capacity. Handles very complex word associations flawlessly. Recommended default: claude-3-5-haiku.
settingsCustomGuideDesc: Connect to local LLM frameworks like Ollama or LM Studio. Point your endpoint URL (e.g., http://localhost:11434/v1) and custom model name.
settingSolveSpeedNotice: Instant mode completes the board in milliseconds. Stealth mode mimics human behavior with randomized pacing (1–3 seconds) to secure streaks against automated detection.
settingDefaultSolveModeNotice: Select the primary action when triggering the solver from tab view or boards. Full Solve finishes the game; Hint Mode places one correct item.
settingsChromeBuiltInGuideDesc: Runs completely locally on your device inside the browser. Zero network latency and 100% free with Gemini Nano.
debugNoMainTagCaptured: No active <main> tag captured. Ensure you are on a LinkedIn game screen.
debugNoLogsCaptured: No logs captured yet. Perform actions on the game screen to trigger console events.
debugListeningEvents: Listening for console.log, console.warn, and console.error events...
debugErrorInitializing: Connection with LinkedIn Game page is initializing...
debugErrorNotGamesPage: Active tab is not a LinkedIn Games page. Navigate to a game to capture details.
debugErrorNoActiveTab: Could not identify the active tab.
settingEnableRemindersDesc: Warn me before today's streak expires.
settingReminderTimeNotice: Select local time to check for unsolved games.
notificationMessage: Don't lose your solving streak! You haven't solved today's LinkedIn games yet.
commandSolveActiveGame: Solve the active LinkedIn game automatically.
commandGetSingleHint: Provide a single-step hint or check for mistakes.
settingAutoOpenSidepanelDesc: Automatically open the solver's side panel when visiting LinkedIn Games.
permissionDialogDesc: To detect active game boards and solve puzzles, the extension needs permission to run on LinkedIn Games. Click below to grant access.
waitingForLinkedInGamePageDesc: Navigate to any LinkedIn Game board tab (Queens, Sudoku, Tango, Pinpoint) to capture constraint coordinates, cell states, and reactive structures.
consoleStreamEmptyDesc: No log outputs detected matching filters. Run steps inside LinkedIn Games solver UI to stream log actions here.
parsingGameGridCells: Parsing game grid cells... Ensure the board has active grid blocks visible.
telemetryToggleDesc: Help improve the solver by sharing anonymous performance & usage metrics.
